question: How does the same purifier come to be counted as thirteenfold and fourteenfold?
premises: Divisions of one, two, three, and four yield a thirteenfold form.
The same entity is also considered in the mode of a single heroic power.
In that mode it is established as fourteenfold.
inference: The same purifier is thirteenfold by the divisions of one, two, three, and four, and becomes fourteenfold when taken in the single-hero mode.
uncertainties: The exact accounting that produces thirteen and then fourteen is not fully itemized in this verse.
plain_english: By divisions of one, two, three, and four it is thirteenfold; and this same one, taken in the single-hero mode, stands as fourteenfold.
